request.purpose: This common release packet supplies the actual request and new artwork equally to both model authors.

protocol.purpose: This on-demand trial withholds a historical change until independent baseline models are frozen.
protocol.information_access: Procedural allowlists in an unrestricted shared filesystem; any disclosure is recorded and invalidates the affected agent for the blind claim.
protocol.baseline_support: Same neutral requirements, scalar interfaces, contour/SVG inputs and geometric reference scope; engine-specific ordinary documentation and generic APIs are allowed.
protocol.builders: Fresh agents with no inherited chat history; same model and harness defaults.
protocol.editors: Each original blind builder receives the challenge only after both accepted baselines are frozen.
protocol.cache_policy: Use installed runtimes and existing ordinary caches; record setup, host waits and cache conditions.
deliverables: Colored display geometry in native 3MF or ordinary hsm payload
protocol.acceptance: Manual observation against packet requirements at hsm kernel LINEAR. Equivalent solids and colors are accepted without matching topology or triangle ordering. No physical print qualification is implied.

protocol.publication: The root agent integrates both into the existing isolated lab with the same renderer and website deployment; publication work is recorded separately.

freeze.purpose: This record binds the accepted independent baselines before the later request is released.

baseline_acceptance.purpose: This focused review compares the blinded baseline exports with their packet requirements.
baseline_acceptance.method: Packet-derived sections, native editable source inspection, mesh topology and sampled surface distances; no rebuild.
baseline_acceptance.scope: Sampled distances are not an exhaustive Hausdorff proof or physical print qualification.

after_acceptance.purpose: This focused review accepts the released word change against the frozen baselines.
after_acceptance.scope: Only changed p03 receives geometry processing. Other parts are accepted by exact frozen source/data/export hashes. Native editable source state, material sections, counters and printable outputs are checked. Common website publication is separate.
after_acceptance.distance_scope: Vector outlines use a bounded fine approximation; bidirectional surface distances cover finite samples.

native_document_changes.description: The saved artwork sketch and word-body relationships contain the released DRAIN outlines. Exact curve controls are checked separately.

publication.scope: The same existing renderer and static website deployment publish both implementations. Common integration, independent review, staging, commit/deployment and browser verification are separate from each author editing its model.

limitations: A single historical case selected by a custodian; no general or statistical performance claim.
Fresh builders receive no chat history. Allowed file access is controlled by instructions in a shared unrestricted filesystem; both authors report no forbidden exposure.
Exact earlier and replacement lettering contours are provided equally. Font generation and typography layout effort are outside this trial.
Both workflows use custom authoring/export programs and the existing web renderer; machinery retirement and full-assembly dependency propagation are not established.
No new physical print or slicer qualification.
conclusion: Both authors handled the withheld lettering change through data/artwork updates while reusing their original geometry construction. All other parts remain byte-identical. This removes advance knowledge of the exact edit from these authors; it demonstrates successful native iteration and an equally reusable Rust construction, without establishing a general speed advantage.
